description: For each of PlainQuant's library stock-picking rules (US and Hong Kong) at default settings: the plain backtest's return a year beside the honest estimate left after costs, delisted stocks and untuned test periods (fractions: 0.05 = 5% a year), the trade count and the test window. Use for 'does momentum / value / moving-average investing work' or 'how much do backtests overstate'.
name: rule_estimates
title: How library stock-picking rules really did
